input: Hi, I ordered the Corrie down jacket in navy under order PW-418205 and it arrived last Tuesday. It's lovely but honestly warmer than I need for what I do, so I'd like to send it back for a refund. Tags are still on and it's never left the house. Could you tell me how to get the return label started? Thanks, Priya

Hello returns team. Order PW-302911 was two Heath merino base layers. I only meant to order one and didn't notice the quantity until the parcel came. Both are still sealed in their bags. Can I return one of them for a refund and keep the other? Let me know what you need from me. Regards, Tomasz

I received the Ridgeback 65 pack (PW-557340) ten days ago. I've tried it on loaded up in the living room a few times and the hip belt just doesn't sit right on me, it digs in on the left side no matter how I adjust it. I haven't taken it outside. I'd like a full refund please rather than an exchange, as I think I need a different brand's fit altogether. How do I proceed?

Hi there, quick one. I want to return the Lomond headlamp from order PW-189476. Nothing wrong with it, I just found I already had one in a drawer. Unopened, tags on, still in the box. Is there a prepaid label in the parcel or do I need to print one? Cheers, Aled

Good morning. My order PW-640022 for the Tarn 2 tent was delivered on the 3rd. We've decided not to go on the trip after all, so I would like to return the tent for a refund. It has not been pitched or taken out of the stuff sack. Please can you confirm the refund will go back to the card I paid with, and how long it takes once you receive it? Many thanks, Helen

Hello, I bought the Skerry rain shell in the sale (order PW-275813). I've since seen it cheaper elsewhere and to be honest the fit is boxier than I expected. It's unworn with the tags attached. I'd like to return it for a refund. Is the sale purchase still covered by your 30 day returns? It's been about a week.

I'd like to return two items from order PW-833190: the Firth beanie and the Whin insulated gloves. Neither has been worn. The beanie colour is not what the photo suggested and the gloves are too bulky for cycling, which is what I wanted them for. Can both go back in one parcel with one label, and will I get one refund or two? Thanks. Marcus

Hi. Order PW-921564, the Moraine sleeping bag. It came on Friday and I opened the compression sack to check the size, but that's all. It's much heavier than the weight listed on the product page, nearly 300g more on my kitchen scales, so it won't work for the trip I bought it for. I'd like to return it for a refund. Do I need to repack it exactly as it came?

Hello, I'm returning the Fellhound boots from order PW-374028. I walked around the kitchen in them for an evening and they rub badly on my right heel. They have not been outside and the soles are clean. Could you please arrange a refund? I'd rather not exchange because I've decided to get fitted in a shop instead. Thank you, Ingrid

Hi, I ordered the Ness sleeping mat (PW-506677) and I'm afraid I need to return it. I opened the box and unrolled it once, and it is simply too narrow for me at the shoulders. I've rolled it back up with the strap. Please could you send me the returns instructions and confirm I'll get a full refund. Best, Rob

Returning the Brae softshell trousers, order PW-698341. I bought them for a walking holiday that's now been cancelled. Still folded with the tags and the little card thing attached. Would like the money back to my card please. What is the address to send them to and do I pay the postage?

Good afternoon. I purchased the Bothy stove and the Reed cooking pot set together on order PW-142890. I've changed my mind about the stove but want to keep the pots. The stove is unused and the box is unopened. Could you confirm I can return just the stove for a refund and that the free returns label covers a partial return? Kind regards, Fatima

Hi team, my order PW-760514 was a Kestrel windshirt in medium. I have not worn it. I ordered on impulse and looking at my finances I need to send it back. Tags on, bag kept. Is it okay to return for a refund within the 30 days even though there's nothing wrong with it? Sorry to mess you around. Danny

I need to return the Larch camp table from order PW-215936. It arrived fine, but when I set it up indoors it's a good bit smaller than I pictured from the listing and won't be much use for our family. It's back in its carry bag, unmarked. Please can you arrange a refund to my original payment. How soon after you get it will the money show up?

Hello. Order PW-483067, Cove dry bag set. I ordered these for a kayaking course that has now been postponed indefinitely. The set is unopened. I'd like a refund rather than credit if that's possible, as I don't know when I'll be doing the course. Thanks for your help, Sanjay

Hi, I received the Dune sun hat on order PW-329758 and the brim is far floppier than it looked online. I wore it for two minutes in front of the mirror and took it straight off. Tags intact. I would like to return it for a refund please. Do you need me to include the invoice in the parcel?

Requesting a refund for the Ard chalk bag, order PW-871402. I have decided against taking up climbing after a session at the wall. The chalk bag is unused and still has the retail tags and hang card. Please let me know how to return it and when I can expect the refund. Regards, Beatrix

Hello returns, I have the Glen fleece from PW-604189 to send back. It was delivered on the 12th. The colour is more grey than the green shown and I don't like it as much in person. Never worn, tags on. Can you send me a label or tell me where the one in the box is? I could not find one. Thanks, Owen

My order PW-957231 (Holm trail runners, size 9) came yesterday. I tried them on the carpet for a few minutes and they are too narrow at the toe box for me. I don't think a size up will fix the width so I'd like a refund rather than an exchange. Soles are spotless. Please advise the next step.

Hi, I'd like to return the Loch water filter from order PW-036718. I haven't opened the sealed inner packaging. I bought it for a trek and then realised our group leader is bringing a gravity filter for everyone. Could I get a refund? And is the return postage free? Thank you, Marguerite

Order PW-528943, two Ling waterproof socks pairs. Unworn, still in their packets. The sizing chart said medium for my shoe size but holding them up they look tiny, and honestly I've lost confidence in them. I'd like to send both back for a refund. What's the process? Thanks, Cal

Hello, I received order PW-713820, the Sett bivvy bag, on Monday. Having read the instructions I don't think it's breathable enough for what I want to do with it. It has not been out of its bag beyond me reading the label. Please can I return it for a refund. I'm within the 30 days by my count.

Hi, I bought the Corrie down jacket in medium on order PW-644120 and it's a touch snug across the shoulders when I layer a fleece underneath. I'd like to swap it for a large in the same colour. Unworn other than trying on, tags still attached. Can you send the large out before I return the medium, or do I have to wait? Thanks, Niamh

Hello. Order PW-290385, Skerry rain shell in olive. I'd like to exchange for the same size in the blue instead, as my partner has the olive one and we'd rather not match. Nothing wrong with the jacket. Tags on. How do I set up an exchange rather than a return? Regards, Idris

I'd like to exchange the Fellhound boots from order PW-118762 for the wide fit version in the same size. I've only worn them indoors for an hour and the standard fit pinches. Can you tell me if the wide fit is in stock in a 43 before I send these back? Thanks, Lena

Hi there, I ordered the Drum daypack 22 (PW-767204) and I've realised a 22 litre bag is a bit small for what I carry to work. Could I exchange it for the Ridgeback 35 and pay the difference? The Drum is unused and in its packaging. Let me know how the price difference is handled. Cheers, Paulo

Good morning, my order PW-453917 was the Heath merino base layer in small. It's shrunk my confidence rather than my body: it's tighter than I'd like and rides up. Can I exchange it for a medium? I've worn it once around the house but not washed it and the tags are still on the collar. Thank you, Astrid

Order PW-902568: Cairn trekking poles. I ordered the standard length but I'm 6'4" and they don't extend far enough for me. I'd like to exchange them for the long version. They've been extended once in the hallway and collapsed again. Do I need a photo for an exchange or just the label?

Hello, I received the Tarn 2 tent on PW-337045 but I now think the Tarn 3 would suit us better as a family of three. Could I exchange, paying the difference? The tent is unopened. Also, would the exchange reset the 30 day return window if the Tarn 3 turns out to be wrong too? Thanks, Greg

I need to exchange the Whin insulated gloves from order PW-581693 for a size larger. Medium is too tight at the knuckles. They're unworn apart from trying on. If the large is out of stock, would you offer store credit instead? Let me know. Best, Yara

Hi, ordered the Glen fleece in black, order PW-224870, and I'd like to swap it for the same size in the rust colour. Unworn, tags on, bag kept. Is there a form to fill in or do I just write on the returns slip what I want instead? Thanks very much. Hamish

Hello returns team. Order PW-815329, Moraine sleeping bag, regular length. I'm 6'2" and it's tight at the feet. Could I exchange for the long version? I opened the compression sack and climbed in for a minute to check, then packed it back. Do you have the long in stock currently? Thanks, Kwame

I'd like to exchange the Brae softshell trousers (PW-069512) for a shorter leg length. The waist is spot on but they pool at the ankle. Tags attached, unworn outside. Can I request the exchange from my account or do I email you? Regards, Sofia

Hi, my order PW-498036 contained the Scree approach shoes in 8. They fit but the laces are a bit short and I'd honestly prefer the low-cut version I've since seen on your site. Can I exchange for the low-cut in the same size? Worn only indoors on the rug. Thanks, Ewan

Hello, I bought the Firth beanie on order PW-350187 in the charcoal. It's fine, but I'd like the mustard instead. Can I exchange? It's been about three weeks since delivery. Not worn. Do I need to send it back first or can you dispatch the new one straight away? Thanks, Leah

Order PW-706241, Kestrel windshirt, size large. Bit big on me, would like a medium please. I've kept the packaging. I'm going away in two weeks so I'm wondering how quickly an exchange turns around once you have my parcel. Any way to speed it up? Thanks, Dev

I want to exchange the Holm trail runners from order PW-136798 for a half size up. Tried them on the kitchen floor and my toes touch the front. Clean soles, box intact. Is the 9.5 available? If not, what's the next best option? Thanks, Christine

Hi, the Ness sleeping mat (PW-627450) is the regular width and I'd like to swap for the wide. I unrolled it once and rolled it back up. I understand the wide costs a bit more, happy to pay the difference. How does that work with an exchange? Thanks, Ivo

Hello. Order PW-984013 was the Tor gaiters in medium. They don't close over my boots, which are quite chunky. Could I exchange for the large? Unused, tags on. I'd be grateful if you could confirm stock before I post them back. Regards, Maud

I'd like to swap the Dune sun hat from order PW-372695 for the next size up; it perches on my head rather than sitting on it. Tags attached, not worn out of the house. Is the exchange free like the returns? Thank you, Anders

Hi, I ordered the Marram sandals in a 6 (PW-541380) and they're too big, my heel slides off the back. Could I exchange for a 5? Only worn on the carpet for a minute. I'd like to keep the same colour if possible. Thanks, Bea

Hello, order PW-263874, the Fern camp chair in green. I'd like to exchange it for the tan colour so it matches the other one we have. It hasn't been unfolded. Do I just use the label in the box and note the swap on the slip? Regards, Callum

My order PW-890527 was a Lomond headlamp. I've realised I ordered the basic model when I wanted the rechargeable one. It's unopened. Can I exchange and pay the difference, and would you be able to send the rechargeable out as soon as you get mine? I've got a night walk coming up. Thanks, Ruth

Hi there, I'd like to exchange the Reed cooking pot set from order PW-417063 for the larger two-person set. The one I got is unused, still in the mesh bag with the tag. I'm happy to pay the extra. Let me know if the larger set is in stock. Thanks, Jonas

Hi, my Tarn 2 tent from order PW-152389 arrived today and one of the poles has a split section, the aluminium is cracked along the join. I noticed it when I unpacked it, it hasn't been pitched. I can send photos. Can you send a replacement pole or a whole new tent? Thanks, Owain

Hello, order PW-738416, the Ridgeback 65 pack. The parcel arrived with a tear in the outer box and the pack's lid pocket zip is bent and won't run. I'm not sure if it was damaged in transit or before. I've photographed the box and the zip. What would you like me to do? Regards, Mira

The Corrie down jacket I received (PW-390257) has a seam split under the left arm about 4 cm long with down coming out. I only noticed after trying it on. It was like that when it arrived. I'd like a replacement rather than a refund as I do want the jacket. Please advise. Thanks, Lars

Hi, my order PW-605840 arrived and the Bothy stove has a dent in the burner head and the valve doesn't seat properly. I have not attempted to light it. The box wasn't obviously damaged so I think it went out like this. Can I get a replacement? Happy to send pictures. Best, Nadia

Hello. Order PW-247193, Skerry rain shell. I put it on to check the size and found the main zip is missing a few teeth near the bottom and won't close. Unworn otherwise, tags on. I'd like a replacement in the same size and colour. What do you need from me?

I received the Moraine sleeping bag (PW-861034) and there's a burn hole or something similar about the size of a coin on the foot section, right through the shell. It was in the sealed bag so it must have happened before packing. Could you replace it? I'm going away on the 20th so timing matters. Thanks, Petra

Hi returns, the Lomond headlamp from order PW-476529 arrived with the battery door snapped off. The plastic hinge is broken and the door was loose in the box. I haven't used it. Would you send a replacement, and do you want this one back? Cheers, Sam

Order PW-013687: Fellhound boots. The left boot has a deep scuff across the toe and the eyelet second from the top is torn out of the leather. These are clearly not new condition. I've taken photos. I'd like a replacement pair in the same size. Please let me know how to proceed. Regards, Constance

Hello, my Cairn trekking poles (order PW-592748) came with one pole's locking lever snapped clean off. The lever was rattling around in the tube. I'd like a replacement pole or a new pair. Also, should I send the broken one back or dispose of it? Thanks, Fergus

Hi, I got the Ness sleeping mat on PW-329061 and inflated it to check it. It has a slow leak, it's flat by the morning. There's no visible puncture, I think the valve is faulty. It was straight out of the box. Can I have a replacement please? Thank you, Alba

The Reed cooking pot set from order PW-784215 arrived with the lid of the large pot bent so it doesn't sit flat, and the frying pan handle won't lock. Looks like the parcel was crushed, the box was squashed at one end. I'd like a replacement set. I have photos of the packaging. Regards, Teodor

Hello, order PW-148376, Larch camp table. One of the leg hinges is cracked and the leg wobbles badly. I unfolded it once on the kitchen floor to check it. I think a replacement is the answer but let me know if you can send just the leg. Thanks, Wren

Hi, my Cove dry bag set (PW-967120) has one bag with the roll-top strip peeling away from the fabric along most of its length. The other two are fine. Can I get just that one replaced or do you need the whole set back? Cheers, Nikolai

Order PW-431802, Whin insulated gloves. The stitching on the right thumb has come undone out of the packet, there's a gap you can put your finger through. Not worn. Please replace. Do you want a photo first? Thanks, Jules

Hello. I received the Ard climbing helmet from order PW-256439 and the shell has a crack running from one of the vents. Obviously I'm not going to use it like that. I'd like a replacement, and I'd rather this one didn't go back into stock. What's the process? Regards, Hollie

Hi, the Glen fleece I ordered (PW-673958) came with a pull in the fabric on the front and a small hole near the hem. It looks like it caught on something before packing. It's unworn, tags on. Can you send a replacement in the same size and colour? Thanks, Xander

My Kestrel windshirt from order PW-508294 arrived with a large greasy mark down the back that won't come off with a damp cloth. Otherwise brand new with tags. I'd like a replacement please rather than a refund. Should I send this one back with the prepaid label? Thanks, Adaeze

Hello, order PW-825617. The Loch water filter arrived with the housing cracked and the inner packaging was wet, I think the filter cartridge has been soaked. I don't want to use it. Please can you replace it? I've got pictures of the damage and the wet packaging. Regards, Bram

Hi, I got the Fern camp chair (PW-390716) and the fabric seat has a rip along one side seam where it attaches to the frame. Unused. I would like a replacement chair. Do I keep the frame and just return the seat, or the whole thing? Thanks, Marnie

Order PW-064283, Holm trail runners. The right shoe has the sole partly unglued at the heel, it flaps when I lift it. Out of the box like that. I'd like a replacement pair. If you don't have the same colour in stock I'd take another colour. Thanks, Dara

Hello returns, the Tor gaiters from order PW-719350 arrived with the under-boot strap missing on one gaiter and the buckle broken on the other. Can I have a replacement pair? I need them for a trip in ten days. Thank you, Elin

Hi, my Sett bivvy bag (PW-547902) arrived with the zip pull missing and the zip itself jammed halfway. I've not taken it out of the house. Replacement please, and let me know whether you'd like the faulty one returned with the label. Regards, Otto

Hi, I'm afraid I've left this a bit late. I bought the Corrie down jacket on order PW-231578 about six weeks ago and never wore it, it's been in the wardrobe with the tags on. I've now realised it's not for me. I know I'm past 30 days, is there anything you can do? Thanks, Joanna

Hello, order PW-598104, Fellhound boots. They were delivered 45 days ago. I'd hoped to break them in indoors but I've only just tried them and they don't fit. Soles are clean. Can I still return them, even for credit? Regards, Amir

Hi, I want to return the Ridgeback 65 pack from PW-347629. It arrived at the start of the month before last, so around seven weeks ago. I was in hospital for a chunk of that and it's been sitting in the box. Unused. Is there any flexibility on the 30 days given the circumstances? Thank you, Rosalind

My order PW-910246 (Skerry rain shell) was delivered nine weeks ago. I've worn it maybe twice on short walks. It's not as waterproof as I hoped, the shoulders wet through in steady rain. I know this is well outside the return window. Is this something the warranty covers, or am I stuck with it? Thanks, Paddy

Hello. I ordered the Moraine sleeping bag (PW-482735) 38 days ago and it's unused. I'd like to return it. I understand I'm past the refund window. Could I exchange it for the lighter Moraine model instead, or get store credit? Let me know my options. Thanks, Chidi

Hi there, order PW-165893 was the Tarn 2 tent, delivered in early spring. It's now been about two months. We never got to use it, still sealed. I don't suppose a return is possible at this point? Even a partial refund would be appreciated. Regards, Vera

Hi, I bought the Bothy stove on PW-726510 five weeks ago. Unopened box. I've since been given one as a present. Can I still send it back? Store credit would be fine if a refund isn't possible. Thanks, Keir

Hello returns. My Glen fleece (order PW-053467) came 33 days ago. I'm three days over and I feel a bit silly, I just forgot. Tags on, never worn. Is there any leeway for a refund, or is credit the best I can hope for? Thanks, Maya

Order PW-641298, the Brae softshell trousers, were delivered just under two months ago. Worn once. The stitching on one back pocket has started to come away. I know I'm outside 30 days, but this seems like a fault rather than wear. Can you help? Regards, Stefan

Hi, my Lomond headlamp from PW-378051 arrived seven weeks ago and I've only now opened the box. I ordered the wrong model. Could I exchange it for the rechargeable one and pay the difference? I appreciate I've missed the return window. Thanks, Imogen

Hello, I have the Cairn trekking poles from order PW-894627 which came 50 days ago. I used them on one walk and one of the locks has started slipping. Not sure whether this counts as a return or a warranty thing at this point. What would you suggest? Thanks, Barnaby

I bought the Heath merino base layer (PW-207384) about five weeks ago. Unworn, tags attached. Between work and a house move I didn't get round to trying it. It's a size too big. Would you accept an exchange for a smaller one at this stage? Regards, Sunita

Hi, order PW-560179, Whin insulated gloves, delivered 40 days ago. I haven't used them because winter was over. Can I return them for a refund to my card? If not, I'd take credit towards a summer pair. Thanks, Lorcan

Hello. I bought the Kestrel windshirt (order PW-439805) and I'm now around 65 days on from delivery. It has been worn a few times. I've decided it's not really what I wanted. I suspect I'm well past any return options but wanted to check. Thanks, Delia

Hi, my Larch camp table from PW-982361 was delivered about six weeks ago. Unused, still strapped in its bag. We ended up borrowing one for our trip. I'm past the 30 days but hoping you'd still take it back for credit at least. Regards, Aurelio

Order PW-318750: Dune sun hat. Delivered 35 days ago. Never worn, tags on. I got distracted and missed the deadline by a few days. I'd love a refund but understand if it has to be an exchange or credit. Thanks, Poppy

Hello, I received the Loch water filter (PW-675042) roughly seven weeks ago. I opened it last weekend for the first time and the pump handle is stiff and grinding. It's not been used on a trip. Does this fall under the warranty since I'm past the return period? Thanks, Nico

Hi, I'd like to return the Fern camp chair from order PW-146927. It arrived 44 days ago and was unfolded once. It's a bit low for my knees. I know I'm late. Would you accept it back for an exchange to the taller model? Thanks, Esme

Hello returns team, I have the Marram sandals from PW-803514 which were delivered 55 days ago. Worn indoors twice, never outside. They squeak when I walk which drives me mad. Any chance of an exchange or credit this far out? Regards, Tobias

Hi, the Ness sleeping mat (order PW-527836) came about five weeks ago. Unused. I ordered two by accident and only noticed when I went to pack for a trip. Is there anything you can do about the spare one now that I'm past 30 days? Thanks, Ffion

Order PW-269148, Drum daypack 22. Delivered about 32 days ago. I've used it twice to commute and it's fine, I just prefer my old bag. I gather I'm out of the refund window. Could I get store credit for it? Thanks, Reuben

Hi, I bought the Skerry rain shell about eight months ago (order PW-104372). The taped seams on the hood have started lifting and it now leaks along the hood seam in rain. I've washed it as instructed and reproofed it once. This seems like a manufacturing issue. How do I make a warranty claim? Thanks, Gwen

Hello, my Fellhound boots (PW-782604) are about a year old and the sole has separated from the upper on the left boot at the toe. They've done maybe 300 km on paths and tracks, nothing abusive. I'd like to claim under the two year warranty. What information do you need? Regards, Aiden

Hi returns, I'm writing about the Ridgeback 65 pack from order PW-395168, bought last autumn. The main zip on the front pocket has failed, the slider has come apart from the teeth. The pack has been used on a handful of weekend trips. Can this be repaired or replaced under warranty? Thanks, Solveig

My Corrie down jacket (order PW-611249) is 14 months old and the baffles along the back are leaking down badly through the stitching, not through the fabric. I have only washed it once, by hand, as per the label. I think this is a stitching fault. Can you help under the warranty? Thanks, Malachy

Hello, the Tarn 2 tent I bought on PW-248097 about ten months ago has a pole that has started to bow permanently, and the shock cord inside has gone slack. Used on about six nights total. Is this covered? And if so, do you replace the pole or the tent? Regards, Hanna

Hi, I have the Bothy stove from order PW-537916, purchased last year. The igniter has stopped working after about twenty uses. It still lights with a match but the igniter was the point of paying more. Would this be covered under warranty or is it classed as wear? Thanks, Emil

Order PW-069731, Lomond headlamp, bought around nine months ago. It's started switching itself off after a couple of minutes even with fresh batteries. It hasn't been dropped or got wet beyond drizzle. I'd like to claim under warranty. What do you need from me? Thanks, Kirsty

Hello. My Moraine sleeping bag (PW-856420) is about 18 months old and the zip has split on the inside seam so it won't stay closed. Used on maybe 15 nights. The bag's otherwise in good nick. Can this be repaired under the warranty rather than replaced? I'd prefer that. Thanks, Roderick

Hi, the Cairn trekking poles from order PW-413058 are just over a year old. One of the carbide tips has fallen out and the lower section on that pole has cracked at the tip. They've been used regularly on ordinary hill walks. Is that warranty or wear? Regards, Louisa

My Brae softshell trousers (PW-720693) have gone at the crotch seam after about seven months. The fabric isn't worn, the stitching has just given way. I have worn them a lot but nothing unusual. I'd like to claim under the warranty please. Thanks, Callan

Hello, order PW-187352, Loch water filter, bought last summer. The pump has started leaking from the housing seam and the flow rate has dropped right off despite cleaning as per the instructions. Is the filter covered by the two year warranty? Thank you, Anneli

Hi, I bought the Whin insulated gloves on PW-964815 about a year ago. The palm on the right glove has split along the seam, not from wear, the leather is fine either side. Would this be a warranty claim? I'm happy to send photos. Regards, Dmitri

The Heath merino base layer from order PW-302640 has developed holes along the shoulder seams after roughly eight months of regular wear and cold washing. I've had other merino last years. Is this something the warranty covers, or is it treated as wear? Thanks, Cerys

Hello. My Kestrel windshirt (PW-651987) is about 11 months old. The elastic in the cuffs has completely gone slack and the cuffs flap open. The rest of the top is fine. Would you consider this a manufacturing fault under warranty? Thanks, Benedikt

Hi returns, order PW-498204, Ness sleeping mat, bought last spring. It's developed a delamination bubble in the middle where the internal baffle has let go, so it's now a lump. Never punctured, stored flat. This looks like a construction failure. Can you help? Regards, Thea

My Glen fleece from PW-273861 has pilled terribly and one of the pocket zips has broken after about six months. I wear it most days. I understand pilling may be wear, but the zip failing seems like a fault. Can the zip be dealt with under warranty? Thanks, Innes

Hello, the Ard climbing helmet I bought on order PW-830549 last year has the chin strap stitching coming away on one side. The helmet has seen maybe 30 sessions indoors. I'm not comfortable using it. Does the warranty cover this? What's the process? Thanks, Rhona

Hi, I have the Reed cooking pot set from order PW-115376, about a year old. The non-stick coating on the frying pan is flaking off in large pieces after normal use with the supplied utensil. I'd like to claim under warranty for the pan. Thanks, Amos

Order PW-746290, Holm trail runners, bought around ten months ago. The upper mesh has torn at the flex point on both shoes. They've done about 400 km on trails. I know shoes wear but this is the upper failing, not the sole. Is it a warranty matter? Regards, Saoirse

Hello, my Cove dry bag set (PW-589127) is about 15 months old and the welded seam on the medium bag has opened up along its whole length. It's never been overstuffed or dragged. Can I claim for that one bag under the warranty? Thanks, Piet

Hi, I bought the Fern camp chair on PW-327904 last year. The weld on one of the frame joints has cracked and the chair collapses sideways. I'm well within the normal weight limit. I'd like to claim under the two year warranty. Do you need the chair back? Thanks, Orla

Hi, I was given the Corrie down jacket as a birthday present. My sister ordered it, I think the order number is PW-682435 from the gift receipt. It's the wrong size for me, a medium and I need a large. Can I exchange it myself or does she need to do it? Thanks, Carys

Hello, my husband bought me the Fellhound boots (order PW-207159) for Christmas. They're a size too small. I have the gift receipt. I'd rather not tell him they don't fit, so could I exchange them for a bigger size without him being contacted? Thank you, Annette

I received the Ridgeback 65 pack as a gift for a trip that's now been cancelled. The order number on the slip is PW-936812. It's unused, tags on. I'd like to return it. I know a refund goes to the buyer; would store credit to me be an option instead? Thanks, Theo

Hi, a friend gave me the Lomond headlamp (order PW-541270) and I already own the same one. It's unopened. Do you offer exchanges on gifts? I'd like to swap it for a Firth beanie or similar. I have the gift receipt but not the original order confirmation. Thanks, Mattie

Hello returns. My dad ordered me the Skerry rain shell (PW-118493) but he guessed the size and got a small. I need a medium. He'd prefer to sort it himself but he's not great with email. Can I just handle the exchange with the gift receipt? Regards, Flora
